issue.title: [Bug] Codex 压缩对话时 vLLM 拒绝历史中的 custom_tool_call 输入项
issue.body:
## 问题

使用 Codex Desktop（ChatGPT.app，bundle id `com.openai.codex`）时，把模型指向 magpie 的 `localhost/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`，上游是 `http://127.0.0.1:12001/v1` 的 vLLM。该 provider 的 nativeCompaction 未开启，压缩摘要由 magpie 生成。

长对话达到上下文上限后，Codex 发起压缩请求，收到：

```json
{"error":{"code":null,"message":"localhost: Unsupported input item type: custom_tool_call (parameter=input)","param":"input","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

会话记录（`~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/27/rollout-2026-10-27T12-35-43-...jsonl`）显示这次任务的两次尝试都失败：第一次是上下文超限（`context_length_exceeded`），第二次是上面的输入项类型错误。

## 原因

1. 压缩请求进入 `handle` 后，`codexInputAs` 把 `compaction_trigger` 改写为摘要提示，并把 `tools` 置为空数组，历史原样保留。历史中的自定义工具调用以 `custom_tool_call` 和 `custom_tool_call_output` 输入项存在。
2. 请求进入 `attempt`，该模型的 `customToolRefused` 标记尚未建立，`customOff()` 返回 false，请求经 `passthrough` 原样发给 vLLM。
3. vLLM 返回上面的 400。`passthrough` 中判断自定义工具被拒绝使用 `customToolRefusal` 正则（#2656 引入），该正则匹配 `tools` 数组相关的措辞，输入项类型的措辞不在其中。
4. `hasCustomTool` 只检查 `tools` 和携带 `tools` 的输入项。压缩请求的 `tools` 为空，历史中的调用不会被认作自定义工具。该函数开头的提前返回判断使用 `"custom"` 字面量，`custom_tool_call` 不包含这个片段，函数提前返回。
5. 模型没有被标记，也没有触发翻译后重试，每次压缩都会得到同一个 400。

## 修复方式

- `customToolRefusal` 增加输入项类型的措辞：`Unsupported`、`Unknown` 或 `Invalid`，可选的 `input`，`item type`，可选引号，然后是 `custom_tool_call`。`custom_tool_call_output` 由 `custom_tool_call` 前缀覆盖。
- `hasCustomTool` 识别 `input` 中 `type` 为 `custom_tool_call` 或 `custom_tool_call_output` 的项，提前返回判断从 `"custom"` 改为 `"custom`。
- 上游拒绝后，`passthrough` 标记模型后返回未完成状态，`attempt` 继续处理。请求在同一个 Responses API 上翻译，历史中的自定义工具调用改写为 `function_call` 和 `function_call_output`，摘要请求正常完成。

## 验证

- 新增 `TestCustomToolCallItemTranslatedWhereRefused`：历史包含自定义工具调用、`tools` 为空，上游以本次错误响应拒绝。修复前返回 400，修复后第二次请求包含 `function_call` 和 `function_call_output` 并返回 200。
- 新增 `TestCodexCompactOverCustomToolCalls`：Codex 压缩请求携带 `compaction_trigger`。修复前返回同一个 400，修复后得到摘要。
- 扩充 `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings`：覆盖本次错误响应和带引号的 `custom_tool_call_output`，并确认无关的输入项类型不会匹配。
- `go test ./internal/gateway -run 'TestCustomTool|TestCodexCompact'` 通过。
- `gofmt` 和 `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway` 通过。

复现环境：magpie v0.1.1681（main `ea7c0067`）。

comments.body:
按 issue 里的修复方式补了一个 fork 分支，基于当前 main `8abdf53a8`（之前 10-28 写的分支基座已经落后，rebase 时把 #3392 后加进 `customToolRefusal` 的 `unknown variant` 备选保留了）。

**根因**（与 issue 分析一致）：压缩请求 `tools` 为空数组、历史原样保留 `custom_tool_call` / `custom_tool_call_output` 项；`customToolRefusal` 只认 `tools` 数组相关的措辞，vLLM 的 `Unsupported input item type: custom_tool_call` 不匹配；`hasCustomTool` 开头用带引号的 `"custom"` 字面量提前返回，`custom_tool_call` 项里没有这个片段——于是模型不会被标记，也不触发翻译重试，每次压缩都拿到同一个 400。

**分支改动**（[skygunner:fix/3849-codex-compaction-custom-tool-call](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3849-codex-compaction-custom-tool-call)，head `3befa94e`）：

- `customToolRefusal` 增加 input item type 措辞的备选：`(unsupported|invalid|unknown) (input )?item type … custom_tool_call`，带引号的 `custom_tool_call_output` 由前缀覆盖；#3392 的 `unknown variant` 备选保持不变。
- `hasCustomTool` 直接识别 `input` 中 `type` 为 `custom_tool_call` / `custom_tool_call_output` 的项，提前返回的字面量从 `"custom"` 放宽为 `custom`。
- 上游这样拒绝后照旧标记该模型并走翻译重试：历史中的自定义工具调用改写为 `function_call` / `function_call_output`，压缩摘要请求正常完成。

**验证**（`GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8`）：

- `TestCodexCompactionOverCustomToolCalls`（stream true/false 两态）和 `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings_VLLM` 在干净 main `8abdf53a8` 上红（正是 issue 里的 400 原文），分支上绿。
- #3392 / #2656 的既有用例 `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings`、`TestCodexCompactsThroughXAI` 不变绿；`TestCustomTool|TestCodexCompaction|TestCodexCompact` 邻域全绿；全套 `./internal/gateway` 只有两条与本改动无关的既有红（`TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged` 在干净 main 上同样红，本机有 Claude 缓存所致；`TestCodexPoolSaysTheClientsVersion` 顺序相关，单跑两棵树都绿）。gofmt / vet / build 干净。

**未验证**：没有真实 vLLM 环境端到端跑过（测试用脚本上游复现 issue 的 400 原文）；`-race` 未跑。

这是 fork 分支，供 review，不主张 issue 归属。

Yielding to @skygunner's fix branch — I verified it independently instead of opening my own.

**Mechanism, ring by ring** (checked against upstream/main `e17b6cefc`)

| Ring | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| Compaction rewrites the request | `codexInputAs` (internal/gateway/codex_backend.go) replaces a `compaction_trigger` with the summary prompt and sets `"tools": []` for a magpie model without native compaction; history items pass through its `default` branch untouched, so `custom_tool_call` / `custom_tool_call_output` items stay in the input |
| Refusal not recognized | The relay's 400 check (`customToolRefusal.Match && hasCustomTool`, internal/gateway/gateway.go) fails twice: the regex only knows tools-array wordings (`unknown variant \`custom\``, `unsupported tool type \`custom\``), not vLLM's `Unsupported input item type: custom_tool_call`; and `hasCustomTool` early-returns unless the body contains the quoted literal `"custom"`, which a `custom_tool_call` type never is |
| Stuck forever | Nothing gets marked unfit, so no translation retry — every compaction gets the same 400, as reported |
| The fix | The regex gains an `(unsupported|invalid|unknown) (input )?item type … custom_tool_call` alternative (a quoted `custom_tool_call_output` is covered by the prefix); `hasCustomTool` returns true for input items typed `custom_tool_call` / `custom_tool_call_output`, and its early-return literal drops the quotes; after the 400 the model is marked and the retry translates the calls to `function_call` / `function_call_output` on the same API |

**Verification** (my own runs, on a clean `git am -3` of the branch onto upstream/main `e17b6cefc`; applied cleanly, no conflicts — the branch is based on `8abdf53a8`, 186 commits behind tip, with zero drift on the touched files, and the ammed files are byte-identical to the branch):

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `TestCodexCompactionOverCustomToolCalls` + `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings_VLLM` on clean tip, test file only (no fix) | RED — both fail with the report's exact 400 body (`Unsupported input item type: custom_tool_call (parameter=input)`) |
| Same tests with the fix | GREEN — stream false and true; the refusing upstream is asked exactly twice, the second ask carries `function_call` and no `custom_tool_call` items, the fallback provider is never asked |
| Neighbors (`-run 'TestCustomTool|TestCodexCompact'`) | ok |
| Full `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 25m ./internal/gateway/...` | ok 636.7s, 0 failures |
| gofmt (after `tr -d '\r'`) and `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway` | clean |
| #3392's `unknown variant` alternative kept beside the new alternative after the rebase | confirmed present in the regex |
| Freshness | upstream/main still at `e17b6cefc`, touched surfaces unchanged, no fix for #3849 landed upstream |

Branch: [skygunner/magpie `fix/3849-codex-compaction-custom-tool-call`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3849-codex-compaction-custom-tool-call) (head `3befa94eeffc46bff09726d98105feba9b505247`)

Not verified: no end-to-end run against a real vLLM server (the tests replay the report's exact 400 from a scripted upstream), and `-race` was not run.

AI use: verification performed with AI assistance; all commands and outputs above were run and read locally.

Thanks @yorhaha for the report and @skygunner for the fix branch.

issue.title: [Bug] Codex 压缩时 Qwen Responses 上游拒绝历史中的 web_search_call

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题概述

Codex 会话中出现过网页搜索后，触发上下文压缩/摘要时，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的 Responses 兼容上游拒绝历史中的原生 `web_search_call` 输入项，压缩因此失败。

观察到的错误：

```text
Qwen3.8-Flash: Unsupported input item type: web_search_call (parameter=input)
```

在该会话后续继续时，压缩任务再次以相同错误失败。长会话达到需要压缩的阶段后无法继续。

## 触发条件与影响

- Codex 会话历史里有 `type: "web_search_call"`。
- Codex 发起压缩摘要请求，并将先前历史一并作为 Responses API 的 `input` 发送。
- 当前 Qwen 上游不接受这种输入项类型，返回 HTTP 400。

目前没有保存被拒绝请求的完整 body，也没有提供真实会话记录、凭据或上游地址。错误中的内网 URL 已省略。

## 环境

- 客户端：Codex 桌面端；具体版本未记录。
- 模型：`qwen3-8-flash`（错误中显示为 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）。
- API：Responses 兼容上游。
- Magpie 版本及具体路由配置：未从该次错误记录中确认。

## 期望行为

当上游明确拒绝历史中的某类 Responses 输入项时，希望 Magpie 能识别该兼容性错误，并在安全时将不支持的历史项转换为兼容表示后重试（例如尽量保留搜索上下文的文本形式）；如果无法安全转换，也应避免对相同请求无限重试，并给出清楚的兼容性提示。

## 与已有 issue 的关系

- #3161 讨论搜索历史在 Codex 压缩请求中引发的失败，已知情形是上游因未声明 `web_search` 返回 `response protection is unavailable`。这里上游明确报的是 `Unsupported input item type: web_search_call`，仅补充工具声明可能不能解决。
- #3849 讨论压缩时上游拒绝历史中的 `custom_tool_call`。本报告关注另一种历史输入项 `web_search_call`，以及 Qwen Responses 兼容上游的拒绝。

这次报告只基于 Codex 窗口实际显示的错误；尚未抓取请求体或在独立最小复现中确认 Magpie 收到的原始 payload。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex title generation fails when vLLM rejects grammar-format custom tools

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Problem

With Codex using magpie to reach a vLLM Responses endpoint, session title generation fails with HTTP 400 when the request offers a grammar-format custom tool:

```json
{"error":{"message":"Custom tools with a grammar format are not supported; only free-form text custom tools are accepted.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"tools","code":null}}
```

## Cause and proposed fix

`customToolRefusal` in `internal/gateway/custom_tool.go` recognizes “custom tools are not supported”, but not vLLM's intervening “with a grammar format” phrase. The refusal therefore reaches Codex instead of activating magpie's existing same-Responses-API translation fallback.

The fix adds only the optional literal phrase `with a grammar format ` to that matcher. After this refusal, the existing fallback offers custom tools as functions taking an `input` string and returns calls as `custom_tool_call` items. Subsequent requests for the marked model translate immediately. Upstreams that accept custom tools remain unchanged. Grammar syntax and definition are preserved in the function description; they are not enforced as a grammar format.

Fork branch (one fix commit, based on [f978d0bee](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/commit/f978d0bee4830b28235257b8e0bd539b29d0d2ae)):
https://github.com/nlimpid/magpie/tree/fix/custom-tool-grammar-refusal

This concerns a refusal of `tools[].format`, not the unsupported history input items reported in #3849.

## Verification

The regression fixture uses the exact vLLM refusal above. Before the matcher change, both grammar cases in `TestCustomToolTranslatedWhereRefused` returned HTTP 400 and `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings` failed. Afterward, both streaming and non-streaming cases pass, including same-API retry, grammar-description preservation, custom-tool call reconstruction, immediate translation on the next request, and unchanged passthrough to an accepting upstream. Invalid grammar definitions and unrelated errors remain unmatched.

Checks used Go 1.26.8, temporary test homes and pinned Go caches:

- `gofmt -l` on both changed Go files and `git diff --check`: no output.
- The two regression tests above: pass after the matcher change.
- Neighboring custom-tool, xAI replay and Codex compaction tests: pass.
- `go test -p 4 -race -tags nogui ./internal/gateway -run '^TestCustomTool' -count=1 -timeout 15m`: pass.
- `go vet -p 4 -tags gtk3 ./...`, `GOOS=linux go vet -p 4 -tags nogui ./...`, and `GOOS=windows go vet -p 4 ./...`: pass.
- Linux GUI (`gtk3`), Linux `nogui`, and Windows builds: pass.
- `go test -p 4 -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout 30m` was run twice. The full gateway package passed both times (873.507s and 867.183s). The first run with Bun 1.4.4 failed only at the already reported SOCKS assertion (#2207). The second, with CI-pinned Bun 1.4.2, passed the full plugin package but failed only at `TestDigestChangesOnlyWhenPublished` (`digest_test.go:22: digest ""`), matching #5999. The focused memory failure also reproduces with `-race -count=20` on the unchanged base commit. The full suite is therefore **not green**; neither unrelated issue is included in this patch.

The Codex session-title workflow against a live vLLM instance has not been rerun; verification uses a local HTTP upstream fixture. Windows checks are cross-compilation and vet, not native execution. No GUI files change.
